screen: Registered T1 named-stroke class-drop gap county-held-out residual screen; diagnostic-only unless fixed gates pass

measure_before.T1_gap_definition: Registered T1|R|gap from the pinned official T1 artifact; one linear term, not the T1 covariate emission.

method.feature: Use the frozen registered T1|R|gap output only. Its upstream harness provenance is checked; the screen does not reread or rebuild Overture roads.
method.outcome: Pinned frozen S1 cross-fitted estimator-disagreement residual; no target or reference layer read.
method.validation: Within each official region, hold out each supported five-digit county FIPS in turn; fit on other supported counties in that region.
method.correction: OLS intercept plus one T1 gap term; training-fold feature mean and population SD only, zero-SD scale=1.
method.baseline: Zero correction of frozen S1 residual on identical paired support.
method.metric: Pooled and regional county-held-out ΔR²=(baseline SSE - OOF model SSE)/baseline SSE; 2,000 paired county-block bootstrap replicates resampled within region.
method.urban_rural: Descriptive diagnostics on OOF residual predictions using only provided pct_urban for groups: rural <0.5, urban >=0.5; missing excluded.
method.interpretation_limit: Association with estimator disagreement only; not target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county baseline/model SSE blocks; counties sampled with replacement within each official region

provided_urbanity.source: provided pct_urban, read only for descriptive rural/urban breakdown

interpretation: The single-term registered T1 residual screen failed one or more fixed acceptance gates; retain diagnostic-only and do not integrate.
